quickref.owner: Shared status (Bind Field/Slow Field, Slow Motion Field special, Bind Gun, Glue Bomb; Black Hole likely)
quickref.status: BBG 2014–2023 footage; present in Sep 2026 playtest
quickref.look: Chunky lemon-yellow block 'Z' (#F2EA23–#FDFE03; 2026 #F6FE0E) with thin dark outline, inside two thick white crescent arcs (#DDDCDD–#E5E5E5) forming a tilted orbit ring; floats above the slowed bear's head, ~1–1.5 head widths
quickref.impact_end_result: Marks a slowed player; also shows over your own bear; spin animation unverified

quickref.look: Purple fuel-rod cylinder with lime chevron and green trefoil cap, held low at right; HUD purple-capped white canister
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Placed, no projectile; clip 2 (3 with Ammo+) in 2013–14 HUDs vs wiki 5
quickref.impact_end_result: Translucent green-to-cyan glow (#3EB65C, highlights #86D9B8–#8AF8E5) with slanted light shafts around targets, ~1 bear-height radius; fast radiation disc then detonation

quickref.status: Old version in BBG 2.0 beta (Jul 2013); released 2.1 (Jul 2013)
quickref.look: Boxy dark gun (prior pass); beta rivets are silver hex-nut heads on coiled-spring shanks
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Clip 3 in Nov 2013 (0/3); beta clip 6; released rivet in flight unverified
quickref.impact_end_result: Big mottled hot pink-magenta glowing field with white core (#FC91FC/#FECAFE), bear-sized, some straight box-like edges, ~7 s; beta: two rivets linked by a thin violet beam

quickref.look: Dark launcher with a white saw blade upright at the front
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 3-blade clip; blades dig in edge-up, each in a blue-violet glow pool (#5769DE)
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosion look unverified; gap note's 'pink-white line' is an unrelated rainbow beam

quickref.status: BBR v1.4 through BBG; placed turrets seen in Sep 2026 playtest
quickref.look: White boxy auto-gun, long barrel, team-colour stripe or top (blue or red), dark Z-neck, black X base with feet
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Auto-fire in fixed 100° cone; thin hot-pink/magenta streaks (#F1ADE1), attribution inferred (early wiki: same bullets as Electric Honey)
quickref.impact_end_result: Small pink hits with pale-yellow star pops (inferred); destroyed turret smokes 2 s then vanishes

quickref.look: Short orange-gold barrel with a bright green front face, held at right
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 2-shot clip; 'comically large green-black missile' per wiki; missile in flight not observed
quickref.impact_end_result: Huge dense dark smoke cloud after kills (attribution inferred); victims break into team-coloured bolt-decal chunks (generic death)

quickref.look: Glossy magenta-purple orb held at lower right
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Thrown, 1/1 clip; in flight a small glowing magenta-pink ball with white core (#D67DBB)
quickref.impact_end_result: Orb hovers mid-air inside a big soft green sphere (#2FDE7E) glowing cyan at the core (#39FED2), ~8–10× orb size; victims break into chunks, yellow Z likely

quickref.look: Prickly ball: dark maroon body (#411E25), bright lime lattice, magenta spiky knobs (#8A3480), about head-sized
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Arced throw; HUD 1/2 in 2018 vs wiki 1
quickref.impact_end_result: Slows enemies (yellow Z); no distinct dome seen; possible lavender screen wash unverified

quickref.status: BBG 2.51 (Apr 13, 2018; in-app 'Battle Bears Royale' splash from 2.50)
quickref.look: Small red dragon head with bat wings and a long silver blade, held forward in the right hand
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 3-shot clip (wiki says 4); white glow at the mouth; projectile in flight not seen
quickref.impact_end_result: Big yellow-orange fireballs with flame tongues (#FCFC77 core, #DFA741 edges) at targets; kills follow

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.12 (Oct 2, 2014) [Fan-wiki]; seen in fan footage Oct 2014 and Feb 2016 (BBG 2.24); 2026 unconfirmed
quickref.look: Musket-like sprayer: dark maroon barrel (#4A3432) with white bands, salmon-pink breech (#C16D5E) with grey emblem, yellow collar (#F2B20D), hanging mustard tank (#C79219) with black label; about 0.5x Graham's height visible; raised up and forward to fire [Observed: File:Musket.jpg; FQ4HBNLcHS0 maxres2]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Shotgun-like 'small cone', 1.5 s per shot, 2 ammo (2014 wiki) or 3 (2020 wiki), 4.5 s reload [Fan-wiki]. On screen: one flat, opaque lime jet (#B8DE2F core, #CFEC32 tip, #A1CE2B shade), widest at Graham and narrowing to a point at the target, with a few green flecks [Observed: FQ4HBNLcHS0 maxres2; that it is the MuskIt is Inference]; 3D shape and sound [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Damage plus radiation; a yellow six-wedge disc (#F9CF0B, black hub) seen beside the target in the firing frame [Observed]; Geiger ticks, and at full radiation the shared radiation explosion [Fan-wiki]; a green puff cloud on the edited title card is unattributed [Observed/Unverified]
